question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as order_item_count,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(ov.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_reviews ov
    JOIN orders o ON ov.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            (CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS DATE)) 
        ) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcnt.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcnt ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcnt.product_category_name_english
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM seller_category_sales
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.order_item_count,
    sm.total_sales,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    sr.avg_review_score,
    sp.avg_packing_days,
    tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
JOIN top_categories tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
